title: Web research
requirement: Retrieve attributable primary sources and interact with chosen pages through bounded native commands without another standing research-agent stack.
a_deciding_comparison_would_measure: Freeze required primary-source coverage and citation checks; add a crawler or research service only if current native retrieval demonstrably misses the requirement.
target_hosts: Primary: a new WSL2 Ubuntu-family instance on a Windows workstation, x86_64, 48 cores, 104 GB RAM, NVIDIA RTX 4090 24 GB. Secondary: macOS arm64 laptops. Users: Claude Code and Codex agent sessions on that host.
